user.title: PREdistribuce portal
user.description: Log in to the PRE distribuce customer portal and enter the EAN of the meter to import. Optionally add the HDO receiver command code to also get the low/high tariff schedule.

data_description.hdo_command: The receiver command code (povel), e.g. 605 - printed on your meter or in your contract. Leave empty to skip HDO.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The portal login no longer works. Enter the current credentials.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed: wrong credentials, or the portal blocked the login (reCAPTCHA).
error.invalid_hdo_command: The HDO command code must be a number.
error.unknown_hdo_command: The portal has no HDO schedule for this command code.

init.title: HDO schedule
init.description: Receiver command code (povel) for the low/high tariff schedule. With a code set, consumption is also split into NT and VT statistics. Clear the code to turn HDO off.

data.hdo_history_days: Days of history to split by tariff
data.price_nt: Low tariff (NT) price, CZK/kWh incl. VAT
data.price_vt: High tariff (VT) price, CZK/kWh incl. VAT

data_description.price_nt: Optional. Writes a cost statistic in CZK for the Energy dashboard (choose it under "Use an entity tracking the total costs"). Use the full per-kWh price: supply + distribution + system services + POZE + tax, with VAT. Needs the HDO code.
data_description.price_vt: Same as for NT, for the high tariff.
data_description.hdo_history_days: Used the first time the split is created (one request per day to PRE's HDO history). Later runs only update the latest days.

error.invalid_hdo_command: The HDO command code must be a number.
error.unknown_hdo_command: The portal has no HDO schedule for this command code.
